jobs.wrapper:
#!/bin/bash
set -u
cd /home/satyal/cse-572/Project
start=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
deadline=$(date -u -d '+40 minutes' +%FT%TZ)
printf 'owner=collisionguard-benchmark-audit purpose=bounded-source-replay pid=%s start=%s deadline=%s checkpoint=data/source-audit/benchmarks/ budget=/tmp/collisionguard-benchmark-cache/snapshot-budget.json\n' "$$" "$start" "$deadline" > /tmp/collisionguard-benchmark-job.log
exec timeout -k 10s 40m python3 -u scripts/audit_benchmark_sources.py >> /tmp/collisionguard-benchmark-job.log 2>&1
